findings.detail: A comparative-period Orchard Technologies position was retained as a 2026-03-31 current holding; the flag reports six rows with the same period-leak disposition.

rationale: PP03 is grounded in the raw filing schedule. The exact flagged Orchard Technologies identity appears at table 69 row 40 in the filing's comparative investment schedule, while the current-period Orchard schedule is separately represented earlier (for example table 38 row 46). Retaining the table 69 row in the 2026-03-31 holdings mixes comparative-period positions into the current position set. This is a real comparative-period extraction leak, not a bad validation check.
